opus.problem: The virgin named Mary is in Luke 1:27, not Luke 1:26. The cited verse only says Gabriel was sent to Nazareth in Galilee. Extend the reference to Luke 1:26-27.
Hiram not being pleased with the towns is in 1 Kings 9:12, not 9:11. Extend the reference to 1 Kings 9:11-12.
The people seeing a great light is in Isaiah 9:2, not 9:1. Extend the reference to Isaiah 9:1-2.
